facts.needle: Occurrences of something a record already describes belong in

claims.statement: No secret, token or connection string is committed to this repository, including into gitignored files

enforcement.mechanism: .github/workflows/security.yml runs gitleaks over the history on every push and pull request

verification.mechanism: .gitleaks.toml keeps the default ruleset live for that scan

claims.statement: Dependencies with known high-severity vulnerabilities are visible

enforcement.mechanism: security.yml runs pnpm audit weekly and on pull requests under continue-on-error, so it reports into the log and its check is green whether or not a vulnerability was found; nobody is obliged to read it

verification.mechanism: architecture/security-invariants.md names the mechanism behind each invariant

claims.statement: Lint, typecheck and tests pass on every change, as one command

enforcement.mechanism: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pnpm run quality on every pull request and push to main

verification.mechanism: eslint.config.mjs is the single source of style for that run

claims.statement: pnpm run quality runs composition:check, lint, typecheck and tests, rather than merely existing as a script

enforcement.mechanism: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pnpm run quality on every pull request, and package.json spells that command out as pnpm composition:check, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck and pnpm test

verification.mechanism: package.json is the file that command resolves against, so a step dropped from it is visible there

claims.statement: The harness runs this repository's own test suite under tests/, not only the construct's own tests

verification.mechanism: CI's required job, once every need is green, merges the vitest shards' reports into .construct/reports/vitest.json with Vitest's JSON reporter and fails unless doctor reads the harness as checked

hypotheses.statement: The harness command is stated in three documents rather than in one with two pointers
The dependency audit runs under continue-on-error, so the job reports and cannot fail the build
The published upgrade path names init as the step that writes a model, rather than sync or a command of its own
An occurrence of something a decision already describes is recorded in observations, leaving the decision unchanged
Each preset that declares a syntax policy ships a test asserting the restrictions it resolves, per role
Every string a person reads comes from one vocabulary module that carries a lore-free counterpart beside each entry
The repository runs on the construct it publishes, carrying the manifest and model it writes for others

Every command that composes more than one module carries a composition model of its own, and the harness fails when a model and its rendered doc drift apart, rather than the diagrams being kept current by hand

The one file permitted to spawn a process is exempted by an ignores entry on the whole config object, so the ban on loading code at runtime is lifted there too rather than only the ban on child_process
Every read of a repository doctor does not trust is funnelled into one module by a lint rule that names its reason, rather than by a convention reviewers are asked to remember
Provenance and knowledge are two records, each declaring a schema version of its own, and both refuse a record written by a later build through one shared error rather than one apiece
The paths that reach a published artifact are scanned for personal filesystem paths and unlisted domains as a step of the gate every change runs, rather than as a release-time check
Beside lint, typecheck and tests, the gate checks that three generated artifacts still match what they were generated from — the flow diagrams, the picture of the model, and the documentation nav
